Markets.title: US stocks:  US market posts weekly gains with earnings, inflation data on tap
Markets.summary: US stocks posted weekly gains driven by optimism ahead of third-quarter earnings reports from major financial institutions. Meanwhile, oil prices experienced a dip and subsequent recovery amid conflicting news between the US and Iran.

Markets.title: Gold, silver boom puts US bank trading revenues on track for record $5 billion
Markets.summary: Major U.S. bank precious metals trading desks generated significant profits in the first half of 2026 due to high gold and silver demand. Analysts predict these trading revenues will reach a record $5 billion for the year.

Markets.title: US bull market nears fourth anniversary, but narrow rally raises risks
Markets.summary: The US stock bull market is approaching its fourth anniversary, supported by strong corporate earnings and low volatility. However, heavy reliance on artificial intelligence and a narrow rally among individual stocks are raising investor risks.

Markets.title: Anthem Biosciences block deal: Portsmouth Technologies sells 30 lakh shares worth Rs 250 crore
Markets.summary: Portsmouth Technologies sold 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences for Rs 249.90 crore in a block deal on October 9. The transaction significantly reduces Portsmouth's stake in the company, which recently reported a decline in first-quarter income and profit for FY27.

Markets.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit surges fivefold as income rises
Markets.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a more than fivefold increase in net profit for the second quarter, driven by higher net interest and fee income. The growth was further supported by strong disbursements in new loan products and improvements in asset quality.

Markets.title: Rupee recovers to 96.73 vs US dollar after RBI intervention, but dollar demand persists
Markets.summary: The rupee recovered to 96.73 per dollar following heavy intervention by the Reserve Bank of India. However, persistent corporate demand for dollars and declining forex reserves continue to weigh on market sentiment.

Geo-Political.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced an agreement allowing Russia to sell diesel fuel to the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized the move as a gift to Vladimir Putin that will prolong the war.

Geo-Political.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, prompting the tribunal to condemn the action as an assault on the rule of law. Several member states, including the United Kingdom, have stated that they strongly disagree with these U.S. sanctions.

Geo-Political.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
Geo-Political.summary: JD Vance expressed skepticism regarding the planned military execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad and stated he will not watch it. This event would mark the first military execution in over 60 years.

Geo-Political.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Panama, causing damage to buildings and prompting tsunami warnings for neighboring countries. Videos of the destruction are currently circulating online.

Geo-Political.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian strikes on Russian data centers have disrupted digital services provided by the tech firm Yandex. The company, often referred to as "Russia's Google," has warned customers to expect ongoing issues.

Geo-Political.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
Geo-Political.summary: A left-wing candidate named Hitler Mussolini won a narrow mayoral victory in a remote district of the Peruvian Andes. Exit polls confirmed the election results in the region.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI optimization (AIO) over traditional SEO for organic traffic in 2025.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended adjusting loan overdue rules to match the actual cash-flow cycles of MSMEs. He stated that regulators should avoid using rigid, uniform global standards for these businesses.

Data & Insights.title: EU-China trade breakthrough: Beijing agrees to moderate hybrid car exports by more than half | Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: The European Union and China reached a trade agreement to reduce hybrid car exports to the bloc by more than half. The deal is intended to ease rising trade tensions between the two regions.

Data & Insights.title: Mint explainer: how will the  ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund (SGF) help Indian MSMEs?
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has launched a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to small and medium enterprises. This fund will help MSMEs expand their capacity, adopt new technology, and compete on a global scale.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council decided to remove arrest powers for officers and raise the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore during its October 2026 meeting. Additional reforms include reduced penalties, faster refunds, and simplified registration processes.

Data & Insights.title: Homecooked food gets expensive, vegetarians to pay more than non-vegetarians amid onion, rice, LPG price hike: Crisil
Data & Insights.summary: In September 2026, the cost of a home-cooked vegetarian thali rose to ₹30.8 from ₹28.1 the previous year. Concurrently, the price of a non-vegetarian thali increased to ₹59.5 from ₹56, driven by higher onion, rice, and LPG prices.

Data & Insights.title: India signs pact to address global excess capacity: What is it? Who are the 15 signatories? Check joint statement
Data & Insights.summary: India and 14 other economies signed a pact to address and share information about policies causing global excess manufacturing capacity and market distortion. The signatories will develop coordinated responses to counter these economic practices.

India.title: At CJP Hearing, Centre Brings Up Sexual Harassment Of Policewoman
India.summary: The Centre brought up the sexual harassment of a policewoman during a Chief Justice of India hearing. This occurred a few days after three women journalists accused police personnel of sexual harassment.

India.title: Man Arrested With Marijuana Worth Rs 4.5 Crore At Delhi Airport
India.summary: An Indian passenger arriving from Bangkok was arrested at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport. Customs officials seized 12.85 kilograms of suspected marijuana worth approximately Rs 4.5 crore from the traveler.

India.title: Ambani Heir Faces Tough Questions In Meetings For Record Jio IPO
India.summary: Akash Ambani recently participated in global investor meetings across major international business centers over a four-week period. These meetings are part of preparations for a record-breaking initial public offering for Jio.

India.title: Ahead Of CJP Protest, Internet Cut For 24 Hours Around Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Delhi Police ordered a 24-hour internet shutdown around Jantar Mantar. The restriction was implemented ahead of a planned Citizenship Amendment Act protest.

India.title: Delhi Protests Highlights: Number Of Delhi Metro Stations Shut Cut From 57 To 45, Hours After Supreme Court Order
India.summary: The number of closed Delhi Metro stations was reduced from 57 to 45 following a Supreme Court order. This adjustment occurred ahead of a protest organized by the Cockroach Janata Party against the poll body chief.

India.title: Metro, Rail Curbs, 20,000 Personnel: Delhi Gears Up For CJP's Jantar Mantar 2.0
India.summary: Delhi is deploying over 20,000 security personnel and implementing metro and rail restrictions for CJP's Jantar Mantar 2.0 protest. Authorities have also installed more than 300 CCTV cameras with audio recording capabilities at sensitive locations.

General.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
General.summary: President Trump announced a new trade agreement allowing the sale of Russian diesel. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the deal as a harmful gift to Putin that will prolong the war.

General.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
General.summary: President Trump made a surprising deal with Russia to help lower fuel prices. He took this action to relieve political pressure on his party ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

General.title: NI secretary to ban the Drumcree parade
General.summary: The Northern Ireland secretary plans to ban the Drumcree parade in Portadown. This decision follows a nearly two-week stand-off between Orangemen and nationalist residents on the Garvaghy Road.
